# Spine

Fixture spine manifest for the manuscript assembler tests. Prose around the
block is human-owned; the fenced block is the single ordering truth.

```yaml spine
schema: spine/v1
title: The Undervault Ledger
author: Fixture Author
chapters:
  - id: ch-vault-heist
    title: The Vault Heist
    status: drafted
    part: Part 1 - The Map
  - id: ch-signal-run
    title: The Signal Run
    status: drafted
    part: Part 1 - The Map
```

List order = book order. Insertion or reorder is an edit to this file only.
